vb_textbox.text: At first I started off pressing random keys until I noticed a pattern emerging mainly in the middle section of the game, once I found the gnome that gave me a collection of at least 5 mushrooms and upwards I kept clicking on it until the collection number dropped to below four and then I chose the opposite gnome until he did like wise. It took me a while to realise the gnomes were jumping from side to side, but that was because I was concentrating so hard to keep my fingers on the right keys without going into spasm. Quite a good game, enjoy!
